title: Part Thirteen: Reach: Schools, Universities, Bishops

sections.brief: Catholic schools, universities, hospitals and charities worldwide and by continent (Fides/Annuarium, data to 31 Dec 2023: 229,090 schools, 64.6m pupils, 4.47m university students, 103,951 charity and health institutions incl. 5,377 hospitals); Africa's weight in primary schooling, America's in universities, Europe's in elderly care; US (NCEA 2025-26: 5,829 schools, 1.67m pupils); what makes a school Catholic under canons 803-816 and why that is not Vatican ownership. Figures: stats, compare

Jesuit higher education counted: IAJU 177 (2024 map), 3,452 schools; the '228' and other figures tested; AJCU 28 members (27 US + Belize; Wheeling 2019); Georgetown 1789, Gregorian 1551, Boston College 1863; who governs: lay/mixed boards from 1967-72 (Notre Dame, BC), Land O'Lakes, Ex corde Ecclesiae 1990 and the US Application in force 2001 (mandatum). Figures: stats, time

The 33-university ledger: selection rule (U.S. News 2027 ranks 1-31 = 33 institutions); founding body and present status for each; counts (13 Protestant-founded, 3 Catholic, 10 private nonsectarian, 7 public); Vanderbilt 1914 and USC 1952 separations; UVA as contrast (Rockfish Gap Report 4 Aug 1818, no professor of divinity; charter 25 Jan 1819; opened 7 Mar 1825); Michigan's priest co-founder; what the ledger cannot show. Figures: compare (ledger), stats

The real instrument of reach: canon 377 (pope freely appoints; terna via the nuncio; no new rights for civil authorities); Dicastery for Bishops (Leo XIV prefect 2023-25; Iannone since Sept 2025); 128 nunciatures for 184 states (Jan 2026); China: 2018 agreement renewed 2020/2022, four years from Oct 2024; Shanghai 2023 irregularity; 19 bishops under the deal, seventh under Leo (Datong, Aug 2026), Chongqing Sept 2026; links to other churches by agreement, not appointment: JDDJ 1999 and its extensions, Phanar 2025, Apostolicae curae 1896 and the 2025 prayer with Charles III. Figures: flow, time
